  • Startup Mentality: Outliant began with 5 startup founders, and startup culture is deep in our DNA. It’s a critical advantage that allows us to move faster, be more resourceful, and empower our team at all levels. We are in the early chapters of our journey.

  • World-Class Remote Collaboration: Outliant is (and always has been) a 100% remote company – we have no offices, and our teams are distributed around the world. Given the freedom and autonomy this provides, we require that our people excel in this remote structure.

About the role:

We’re looking to hire a full-time remote Solutions Architect II for Webflow-based projects . You'll be empowered to define your own work and set the technical vision for assigned projects.

Given broad business direction, you'll generate new frameworks, concepts, and methodologies within the solution architecture field. You'll be responsible for crafting your own roadmap and creating challenging yet achievable projects, fostering an environment of continuous learning and growth.

This role requires working in EST (Eastern Standard Time).

Seniority Level: Senior Level

Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Collaboration: Collaborate with stakeholders across various departments to understand their needs and challenges at a strategic level.

  • Complex Requirements Analysis: Analyze complex business requirements and translate them into innovative and future-proof technical solutions.

  • Concept Generation: Generate and promote new concepts, principles, and methods within the solution architecture discipline.

  • Solution Design and Architecture: Design and architect highly scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions, considering emerging technologies and industry best practices.

  • Technology Integration: Select and integrate cutting-edge technologies (hardware, software, cloud) to build robust and efficient solutions, including Webflow, React, Node.js, Google Tag Manager, and Google Analytics.

  • Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to ensure knowledge transfer and ongoing solution effectiveness.

  • Presentation Leadership: Lead presentations and discussions, effectively defending your proposed solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Implementation Collaboration: Collaborate with development teams to ensure seamless implementation of your designed solutions.

  • Optimization Identification: Identify opportunities for optimization within existing systems and propose innovative solutions to improve overall efficiency.

  • Emerging Technologies Monitoring: Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies, actively evaluating and integrating them into your solution strategy.

  • Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Mentor junior Solution Architects and share your expertise by contributing to internal knowledge sharing initiatives.

  • Team Leadership Experience: Demonstrated experience leading and guiding teams to achieve project and organizational goals.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in solution architecture or a related technical role (e.g., software development, DevOps, systems engineering).

  • Hands-on experience with Webflow, ReactJS and Node.js.

  • 3-5 years of experience in solution design and implementation, with expertise in a specific domain (e.g., cloud computing, security).

  • Proven track record of successfully leading and executing complex technical projects.

  • Mastery of a broad range of technical skills relevant to the role, including cloud computing, enterprise architecture, and IT security.

  • Strong ability to generate innovative solutions and develop new approaches within the solution architecture field.

  • Strong communicator who can bridge the gap between technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and consider long-term implications.

  • Experience implementing and managing Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics for web projects.

  • Certification in solution architecture (e.g., AWS/Azure Solutions Architect or Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect) is a plus.

  • Experience with enterprise integration patterns and best practices.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.

  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Ability to create and maintain comprehensive documentation of architecture designs and solutions.

  • Experience with automation and orchestration tools.

  • Familiarity with compliance and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and guide technical teams.

  • Ability to stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.

  • Experience in managing stakeholder expectations and delivering high-quality solutions on time and within budget.

  • A personal computer with stable internet connection.

What’s in it for you?

As a full-time member of our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off.

  • Non-working holidays per country of residence.

  • Pro-rated 13th-month bonus in select regions.

  • Salary increases and performance-based bonuses.

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Monthly internet stipend.

  • Fun and casual work environment.

  • Employee engagement activities and virtual gatherings.

  • We are a diverse, global team!

Sobre o Wellz

Em 2021, o Wellhub fundou o Wellz com o objetivo de democratizar a saúde mental no Brasil. Possibilitamos que empresas ajudem suas equipes a serem mais saudáveis, mais resilientes e mais engajadas. Através da nossa plataforma, é possível realizar atendimento clínico individual online, acessar conteúdos interativos sobre saúde mental e participar de rodas de conversa em grupo. Facilitamos o acesso das pessoas a uma jornada de autocuidado e autoconhecimento que seja ideal para as suas necessidades individuais. A abordagem que utilizamos é a Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental, com intervenções voltadas para a melhora clínica individual e baseadas em evidências.

A oportunidade

O Wellz está crescendo e, por isso, estamos procurando psicólogos e psicólogas com experiência clínica para fazer parte da nossa comunidade. Você receberá pacientes, realizará sessões de psicoterapia, terá acesso a supervisão gratuita e fará parte de uma inovadora solução de cuidado à saúde mental.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia;
  • Especialização ou pós-graduação completa em Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental;
  • Experiência prévia realizando psicoterapia online individual;
  • Inscrição ativa no Conselho Regional de Psicologia (CRP);
  • Habilidades para conduzir atendimentos de forma online;
  • Possuir computador para realização de atendimento clínico, assim como outros equipamentos que garantam a qualidade do atendimento;
  • Ter empresa aberta, cuja atividade seja compatível com serviços psicológicos.

Por que fazer parte do time de parceiros do Wellz?

  • Nova fonte de renda, sem custo extra para se juntar à nossa rede;
  • Acesso a novos pacientes, trazidos diretamente até você;
  • Flexibilidade de horário, com a possibilidade de criar a sua própria agenda;
  • Metodologia comprovada, baseada em dados e tecnologia;
  • Comunidade de terapeutas para dividir aprendizados e melhores práticas;
  • Supervisão clínica sem custo e com orientação direcionada;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub para cuidar da sua saúde de forma integral.

Compromisso com a inclusão

O Wellz é para todas as pessoas, independente da religião, orientação sexual, etnia, gênero e outros. Se você preenche os requisitos necessários, inscreva-se e venha fazer parte dessa rede que só cresce!

Essa oportunidade é referente a uma parceria de prestação de serviços e, dessa forma, não configura vínculo empregatício.

Job description

Se o seu propósito é inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas, você está no lugar certo!

Fundado em Brasília pelas bioquímicas Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, o Grupo Sabin está há 41 anos no mercado. Nos tornamos um grupo de referência em Medicina Diagnóstica, com mais de 7.300 serviços de saúde, desde análises clínicas, diagnósticos por imagem, vacinação e check-up executivo. O Sabin também atua em Atenção Primária à Saúde (APS), com a Amparo Saúde, e lançou no ano passado, a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde, Rita Saúde.

Somos reconhecidos no Brasil e América Latina, como uma das Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar por mais de 18 anos consecutivos. Partimos de uma cultura organizacional forte em um ambiente de respeito, desenvolvimento, diversidade e inclusão. Temos mais de 7.000 colaboradores e estamos presentes em 15 estados e no Distrito Federal em 350 unidades distribuídas de norte a sul do país.

Quer conhecer mais sobre a nossa marca? Então acesse ou ainda em nossas redes oficiais: Linkedin Sabin Medicina Diagnóstica | Instagram @sabinmedicinadiagnostica | Facebook Sabin Medicina Diagnóstica

Formação completa em: Auxiliar em Laboratório, Técnico em Laboratório, Técnico em Enfermagem, Técnico em Análises Clínicas e/ou Patologia Clínica.

Horário da vaga: 40h semanais.

title: Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program
description:
Overview

This is an international staff role based at our Headquarters in Washington, D.C. We offer visa and relocation support.

We improve lives

The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.

About This Position

The Amazonia Forever Unit has rapidly positioned itself as a strategic leader in advancing sustainable development across the Amazonia region. In just three years, it has mobilized over $4.2 billion in operations across eight countries, launched innovative financing mechanisms, including Indigenous-led funds. Coordinated the first loans under the Green Climate Fund and the Amazon Bioeconomy and Forest Management Fund. Through regional networks, knowledge platforms, and global partnerships, the Unit has strengthened institutional capacities, promoted inclusive growth, and elevated the IDB’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.

We are seeking a strategic leader to serve as Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program. This role is central to advancing sustainable and inclusive development across the Amazonia region, which is home to nearly 40% of South America’s landmass. The Unit Chief will lead cross-sectoral efforts, manage funding mechanisms, and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure impactful and cohesive development strategies.

This position will report to the Manager of the Southern Cone Department. It will advise and support the Vice Presidency of Countries and Regional Integration, as well as the CSC, CAN, and CCB Managers, in the preparation, development, and implementation of national and regional dialogues, strategies, and activities related to the Amazonia Forever Program.

What you’ll do

As Unit Chief, you will lead and manage the Amazonia Forever Regional Program within the Bank and its funding mechanisms and coordinate the external partners and networks that are part of the Program.

Regional Dialogues & Country Engagement

  • Coordinate high-level dialogues across Amazonia-region countries, in close collaboration with Country Representatives, to identify shared priorities and build consensus around strategic development goals.
  • Align Amazonia Forever Program goals with Country Strategies, ensuring coherence across sectors and countries.
  • Engage diverse partners and stakeholders to shape initiatives within the Amazonia Forever Program.

Operational Strategy & Policy Development

  • Advise senior management on the formulation of operational strategies, policies, and guidelines tailored to the Amazonia region.
  • Promote implementation of the program’s five key pillars:
  • Combating deforestation and strengthening environmental control and security.
  • Bioeconomy and creative economy.
  • People-centered development.
  • Sustainable cities, infrastructure, and connectivity.
  • Sustainable, low-carbon agriculture, livestock, and forestry.
  • Integrate cross-cutting themes: inclusion of women, Indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants, and local communities; climate, biodiversity, and forest conservation; and institutional capacity and rule of law.

Financing And Resource Mobilization

  • Collaborate with the IDB Global Partnerships Department to mobilize resources from donors and partners.
  • Coordinate and manage various funding mechanisms, including donor resources and IDB’s own funds.
  • Leverage Amazonia Forever’s financial instruments to support strategic solutions for regional development challenges.

Stakeholder Engagement & Community Dialogues

  • Coordinate inclusive engagement with civil society, indigenous and Afro-descendant communities, and traditional Amazonian populations in collaboration with IDB Civil Society Unit.
  • Strengthening partnerships with national and international organizations, donors, and private sector actors.

Knowledge & Innovation Agenda

  • Lead the knowledge and innovation agenda of the Amazonia Forever Program, working in close coordination with the Southern Cone, Andean, and Caribbean Departments to ensure regional integration and strategic alignment.
  • Promote experimental programs and pioneering research to support sustainable development.
  • Oversee development and dissemination of knowledge products aligned with program priorities.

Institutional Partnerships & External Representation

  • Coordinate joint initiatives with IDB Invest and IDB Lab.
  • Ensure integration of cross-cutting themes such as climate resilience, sustainability, and social inclusion within IDB Group.
  • Represent the IDB in global forums and multilateral platforms to promote the Bank’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.
  • Build and strengthen partnerships with other MDBs, international agencies, and private sector actors to support coordinated regional efforts.

What you'll need

  • Education: You hold an advanced degree (master’s or equivalent) from an accredited university in a field of the social sciences or humanities that is relevant to sustainable and inclusive development.
  • Experience: Experience related to advancing sustainable and/or inclusive development in the region.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English, and Spanish or Portuguese.

Professional Experience

  • You have extensive experience conducting strategic-level technical dialogues with diverse groups (e.g. public sector, private sector, civil society, Indigenous and/or traditional communities), including dialogues in matters related to your work.
  • Experience facilitating dialogues and negotiations that directly involved more than one country is a plus.
  • You have experience in connecting strategic-level discussions with realities at the operational level.
  • A working understanding of multi-lateral development banks is advantageous.
  • You have demonstrated understanding of the fundamental economic, socio-cultural, and environmental characteristics of the Amazonian territories within the countries that are the focus of the Amazonia Forever Regional Program.

Requirements

  • Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

  • Staff: International staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement.

What we offer

The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include:

  • A competitive compensation package, including an annual base salary expressed on a net-of-tax basis.
  • Leaves and vacations: 24 days of paid time off + 8 personal days + sick leave + gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Health Insurance: IDB Group provides employees and eligible dependents with a robust medical benefits program that covers medical, dental, vision, preventive care, and prescription drugs.
  • Pension plan: a defined benefit pension plan that provides financial security and supports employees in planning for their future.
  • We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.
  • Hybrid and flexible work schedules.
  • Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center, which provides preventive care and health education for employees.
  • Development support: We offer tools to boost your professional profile, such as mentoring, 1:1 professional counseling, training and learning opportunities, language classes, mobility options, among others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

description:

Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome). Compensation set based on agreed hours / work scope of part-time role (flexible). Engagement: Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact. Reports to: Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

Overview

We're building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight ? moodboard ? concept ? production ? iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, and restraint where it matters.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you have references at your fingertips.
  • Bold but coachable; you can defend strong creative while remaining collaborative.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with; low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress/Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus: light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results.
  • Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

  • Email: ******
  • Share your LinkedIn and portfolio. If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters.

We move fast. The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond. For more about our culture and how we work as a team, check out our Culture & Careers Page.

We really can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Job Description
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures

Additional Information
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT . The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.

  • You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

  • As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

As a Technical Sourcer, you will be responsible for finding, attracting, and engaging top technical talent across the globe to support CommandLink’s rapidly growing Software Team. You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and leadership to build strong pipelines of qualified candidates, leveraging creative sourcing strategies, market research, and outreach campaigns to connect with the best talent in the industry.

Partnership with Recruiting & Hiring Teams

  • Collaborate with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements, technical skills, and team needs.

Market Research & Talent Mapping

  • Conduct research on technical talent pools across LATAM and global markets.
  • Map competitive organizations to identify potential candidate pipelines.
  • Stay current on sourcing tools, trends, and best practices in technical recruiting.

Candidate Experience & Employer Branding

  • Represent CommandLink’s brand and culture in all candidate interactions.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through clear communication and professional engagement.

What You’ll Need For Success

  • 3+ years of experience in technical sourcing, talent research, or recruiting, with a focus on technical roles for SaaS or technology companies (Software, Product, Engineering).
  • Experience sourcing across multiple geographies, with an emphasis on global technical talent.

title: Developer Relations (Americas)
description:
Overview

Runware is building a leading API for all AI. Our platform makes it easy for developers to add advanced media generation capabilities to their products in hours instead of months, without the burden of managing GPUs, scaling, or constant model updates. By combining custom hardware with optimized software and orchestration, we deliver unmatched speed, reliability, and cost efficiency across hundreds of thousands of models. Backed by top global investors, we're growing quickly and building a team to shape the future of AI development.

About The Role
We\'re looking for Developer Relations to be the technical voice connecting our media generation API with the developer community. You\'ll bridge the gap between our engineering team and the developers building on Runware—from indie creators to enterprise teams integrating our generation capabilities into their products.

First and foremost, you must be passionate about generative AI and able to demonstrate it through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, or other hands-on work. We\'re looking for builders with some development experience. You don\'t need to be a superstar engineer, but you should be comfortable writing and debugging code.

This is an intentionally broad role that will flex around your strengths. It could include creating educational content, debugging integrations, supporting developers, building SDKs and integrations, or representing Runware at events and hackathons. You might maintain SDKs or third-party integrations, build new integrations, or contribute workflow examples and tutorials. A key part of the role is bringing value to our ecosystem which could include being active in public — sharing your work, engaging with other developers, and making technical content visible across socials, forums, and communities. You\'ll help Runware have a strong presence where developers already are.

More than just a job title, this is an invitation to join a company that\'s spearheading the future of AI. We\'re looking for people who want to partner with us, explore their passion for AI, and help other developers succeed. Your technical credibility with developers matters most. Everything else is flexible.

Is this role a fit for you?

If you\'re unsure whether you tick every box below but you\'re excited by AI and have something to show, we\'d love to hear from you. This role is designed to flex around the right people. If you\'ve built projects, contributed to communities, or simply can\'t stop experimenting with generative AI, you already have what matters most. We are even open to freelancers who may just want to contribute in one specific area. Apply and let\'s explore how your passion can grow with Runware.

What This Role Could Entail

  • Write and share technical content — blog posts, guides, videos, and walkthroughs — and distribute it across socials, forums, and developer communities
  • Actively manage and grow our developer community across Discord, Reddit, and social platforms, including hosting office hours, AMAs, workshops, and spotlighting community projects
  • Represent Runware at conferences, hackathons, and developer events, and support inbound interest by helping developers go from first experiment to production usage
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for developers using our API across community channels such as Discord, GitHub, and forums, while surfacing documentation gaps and collaborating with the team to improve clarity
  • Maintain and build our SDKs, plugins, and third-party integrations like ComfyUI or Vercel, and create sample projects, code examples, and workflow tutorials

Requirements

  • First and foremost: you are extremely passionate about AI, particularly generative AI or media generation, and can demonstrate this through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, hackathons, or other hands-on work
  • Some development experience. Comfortable working with schemas, APIs, and full-stack concepts (backend and frontend). The exact languages or frameworks you\'ve used matter less than your ability to build and explain working solutions
  • Experience experimenting with AI technologies such as training LoRAs, building advanced workflows in ComfyUI, or integrating AI models into projects
  • A blend of coding ability and AI know-how. You can navigate developer tooling and generative AI workflows, even if you\'re not a senior specialist in either
  • Excellent technical writing skills. Able to explain complex concepts clearly for developers, and actively share that content across forums, socials, and developer communities
  • Active in developer ecosystems from AI/ML Discord servers and GitHub to hackathons, meetups, or developer events. Comfortable representing and amplifying technical work in public

Benefits

We\'re a remote-first team that comes together in person twice a year to plan, collaborate, and celebrate wins. Day to day we keep a few core hours for teamwork, but outside of that you set the schedule that helps you do your best work.

Our environment is fast-moving and ambitious. Big pushes are part of building category-defining products, but we balance that with flexible working, generous time off, and regular retreats so the team can stay sharp and motivated.

  • Generous paid time off - vacation, sick days, public holidays
  • Meaningful stock options - share in the upside you create
  • Remote-first setup - work from home anywhere we can employ you
  • Flexible hours - own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
  • Family leave - paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
  • Company retreats - twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

Join to apply for the Business Analyst role at Tort Experts

About Tort Experts

At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that can truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. About The Role

We are hiring a Business Analyst to strengthen our Client Services team by owning reporting, reconciliation, and proactive analysis across client accounts. This role ensures accuracy in case counts and budgets, surfaces performance insights, and creates scalable reporting solutions that empower the entire team.

The ideal candidate is mid-level, highly analytical, and able to take full ownership of results with minimal oversight. They are adept at spotting trends, building actionable reports, and anticipating issues before they become problems. Over time, this role may evolve into a companywide business analyst position, with broader responsibility for insights and reporting across teams.

Location: Remote (must be available 9am - 5p ET)

What You'll Do

Client Reporting & Reconciliation

  • Case Data Reconciliation: Own the process of reconciling signed case counts between internal systems and client reports, resolving discrepancies independently.
  • Fund Reallocations: Accurately process client requests to move budgets across projects, ensuring all updates are reflected in reporting.
  • Custom Reporting: Deliver accurate, client-ready reports that align with goals and expectations, while continuously improving report templates and workflows.

Proactive Analysis & Insights

  • Issue Detection: Monitor conversion rates, lead quality, and profitability by lead type and field values to proactively spot risks and opportunities.
  • Performance Analysis: Provide insights into client and campaign profitability, pricing effectiveness, and lead monetization trends.
  • Self-Serve Reporting: Build dashboards and recurring reports that give team members visibility into critical KPIs without requiring manual analysis each time.
  • Scalable Insights: Develop frameworks for analyzing trends that can be reused across clients and campaigns.

Operational Excellence & Financial Control

  • Accuracy Safeguarding: Ensure all reconciliations, reallocations, and reports are error-free and backed by clear data sources.
  • Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in reporting and reconciliation, and create scalable solutions that save time and reduce errors.
  • Collaboration: Support the Director of Client Services by taking on data-heavy work, freeing leadership to focus on strategy and client growth.

Client-Facing Support

  • Email Communication: Participate in client email threads to share reconciled numbers, reporting deliverables, and updates related to reallocations.
  • Light Client Interaction: Join occasional client calls to clarify data, while leaving strategic discussions to the Director of Client Services.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years in business analysis, reporting, client operations, or related analytical roles. Experience in legal case acquisition or performance marketing is a plus.
  • Technical Skills: Master level of proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas) and reporting dashboards (e.g., Looker, Omni, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to slice/dice data, reconcile discrepancies, and extract actionable insights across multiple variables (lead type, conversion rates, profitability, etc.).
  • Automation & Tools: Comfortable building repeatable reports, dashboards, and using AI or automation to accelerate data comparison and analysis.
  • Ownership: Able to take responsibility for results with little oversight, quickly becoming the go-to person for reporting and analysis.
  • Communication: Clear, concise written skills for client-facing updates and internal reports.
  • Adaptability: Ability to learn new systems quickly and thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift rapidly.
  • Personal Attributes:
    • Extremely detail-oriented and accuracy-obsessed.
    • High ownership, proactive problem-solver who identifies issues before others see them.
    • Curious and driven to dig into data until key insights emerge.
    • Comfortable in a support role, enabling leadership to focus on higher-level strategy.
    • Growth-oriented, eager to expand from client-level reporting into companywide business analysis.

Benefits

  • Uncapped quarterly profit-sharing bonuses based on company performance
  • 100% company-paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500 level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US based employees):
    • medical (Aetna)
    • dental (Guardian)
    • vision (Guardian)
  • 100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US based employees):
    • $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution
  • 401k plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US based employees)
  • Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage
  • Work from home equipment budget (at company's discretion)
  • Forever remote work environment

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are driven, client-focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top-tier legal representation.

description:

Brazil (São Paulo - Remote

Wellhub (antes, Gympass*) é uma plataforma de bem-estar corporativo que conecta os colaboradores aos melhores parceiros para exercício físico, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e rotina de sono, tudo incluso em uma assinatura que custa menos do que a individual de cada parceiro. Fundada em 2012 e sediada em Nova York, nossa empresa tem uma equipe crescente em 11 países. No Wellhub, você tem a oportunidade de construir a sua carreira em uma empresa de tecnologia de alto crescimento, que coloca o bem-estar como base da sua cultura e, além disso, contribui para fazer de toda empresa uma empresa de bem-estar.

*Grande novidade: Gympass agora é Wellhub!

Estamos felizes em anunciar nossa mudança de marca para Wellhub, um marco significativo na nossa jornada. Essa transformação reflete nossa evolução de “passe para academias” para uma solução ampla de bem-estar para colaboradores. Com nossa identidade atualizada, estamos prontos para embarcar em um capítulo novo e empolgante de crescimento e expansão. Estamos elevando nossa oferta, incluindo uma experiência completamente nova em nosso app e expansão da rede de nossos parceiros de bem-estar. Veja mais sobre isso aqui.

Por que temos um processo Afirmativo?

Esse é um programa de vagas afirmativas para Pessoa Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD). Nós acreditamos em fomentar a diversidade e nutrir um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos têm acesso a oportunidades equitativas e alcançar o seu máximo potencial.
Para alcançar a nossa missão, é essencial garantir que todas as pessoas no Wellhub se sintam acolhidas, valorizadas e empoderadas.

A pessoa agente de CX é quem está na linha de frente do atendimento no Wellhub: responde dúvidas, resolve problemas e garante que cada interação com nossos usuários seja clara e acolhedora. Atuando dentro da área de Business Transformation, esse papel conecta o suporte diário à missão maior da empresa, ajudando a transformar processos internos em experiências simples e eficazes para milhões de pessoas que acessam bem-estar todos os dias.

Como Analista de CX, você será responsável por fornecer uma experiência de atendimento de alta qualidade. Trabalhará para a resolução de problemas e atendimento consultivo de usuários, clientes e parceiros através de diversos canais. Sua missão é garantir a confiança do cliente com a nossa marca a partir de interações eficientes, empáticas e profissionais para promover satisfação e fidelidade.

Dentro da área de Atendimento ao Cliente do Wellhub, atuamos em Tribos com foco no perfil específico do cliente. Neste programa teremos posições dentro dos times de: Risk and Fraud , Partners Experience (New Ventures e Partners) , End Users Experience (End User, Reclame Aqui e Social Media)

  • CX Risk and Fraud (Prevention): Você atuará como um "escudo protetor" do ecossistema Wellhub. O foco será analisar dados para identificar e mitigar fraudes, além de se comunicar de forma empática em casos delicados. Você será fundamental para garantir a integridade e a confiança em todas as interações.
  • Foco do Suporte: Fornecer suporte a usuários, parceiros e clientes em vários canais.
  • Análise de Risco: Analisar dados para tomar decisões sobre usuários com potencial de fraude e reportar comportamentos suspeitos que possam causar perdas financeiras à Wellhub.
  • CX New Ventures: Sua principal função será dar suporte direto a parceiros, terapeutas, personal trainers e usuários finais. Você resolverá questões técnicas e complexas em diversos canais para assegurar uma experiência de alta qualidade.
    • Foco do Suporte: Lidar com questões de parceiros e usuários finais, principalmente por e-mail, chat e WhatsApp.
    • Resolução de Problemas: Avaliar as necessidades dos clientes e escalar problemas para outros departamentos ou equipes técnicas quando necessário.
  • CX Partners: Neste papel, você dará suporte direto a parceiros e usuários finais, resolvendo questões técnicas e complexas, como dúvidas, através de vários canais com o objetivo de garantir uma experiência excepcional para o ecossistema dos nossos parceiros.
    • Foco do Suporte: Servir como o principal ponto de contato, oferecendo suporte a parceiros e usuários finais através de múltiplos canais como e-mail, chat e WhatsApp.
    • Gestão e Conformidade: Utilizar o CRM para fornecer informações precisas e manter a aderência aos procedimentos operacionais para um serviço de alta qualidade.
  • CX Reclame Aqui : Você será responsável por resolver tickets de usuários e parceiros com alto nível de fricção no canal Reclame Aqui. Seu objetivo é manter o selo RA-1000 da marca e elevar a reputação e o valor do Wellhub no mercado.
    • Foco do Suporte: Lidar com casos críticos via e-mail, WhatsApp e telefone, com foco em manter a imagem e reputação do Wellhub.
    • Métricas de Desempenho: Monitorar e respeitar KPIs operacionais como SLA de primeira resposta e Tempo de Resolução Total (FRT).
    • Conhecimento Específico: Conhecimento das métricas, regras e plataforma do Reclame Aqui, além de noções básicas do Código de Defesa do Consumidor (CDC).
  • CX Social Media : Você será encarregado de proporcionar a melhor experiência possível para todos os usuários do Wellhub nas redes sociais e em canais de avaliação, como Instagram, Twitter, Google Play Store e Reddit. O objetivo é garantir um serviço ao cliente extremamente satisfatório e ajudar a criar estratégias focadas no cliente.
    • Foco do Suporte: Gerenciar comentários e mensagens em canais como Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, Youtube, TikTok e comunidades como Reddit.
    • Monitoramento da Marca: Detectar oportunidades e possíveis crises de marca, engajando proativamente em menções ao Wellhub (social listening).
    • Estratégia e Conteúdo: Auxiliar na criação de uma estratégia de mídia social coesa, garantir que a voz da marca esteja sempre relevante e manter-se atualizado com as tendências digitais.
  • CX End User: Esta posição é responsável por auxiliar diretamente os Usuários Finais com dúvidas em vários canais, resolvendo problemas técnicos e complexos para garantir uma experiência excepcional.
    • Foco do Suporte: Gerenciar a comunicação com os clientes (e-mail, chat, telefone) para garantir sua satisfação, fornecendo soluções completas e precisas.
    • Métricas de Desempenho: Monitorar e respeitar KPIs operacionais como SLA de primeira resposta e Tempo de Resolução Total (FRT).
    • Conhecimentos Necessários: Utilizar o Zendesk para fornecer informações precisas ao cliente e manter a aderência aos procedimentos operacionais para um serviço de alta qualidade.
  • Ensino médio/técnico completo é o esperado, sendo uma formação universitária considerada um diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia com CX e suporte ao cliente por escrito em diferentes canais de atendimento e níveis de suporte.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas CRM como Zendesk ou Salesforce. Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados como Google Looker, Tableau ou Metabase é um diferencial.
  • Google Workspace (Google Docs, Sheets, etc.) é um diferencial.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gramática e informática.
  • Português nativo é obrigatório para todas as posições. Inglês intermediário é um diferencial.
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar 8 horas por dia, com escala de trabalho aos finais de semana (para as pessoas que atuarão especificamente em CX End User).

Mesmo que você não corresponda a 100% dos requisitos da vaga, candidate-se! Teremos o maior prazer em receber a sua inscrição e analisar o seu fit em nossa equipe. Lembre-se apenas de observar que a experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente por diferentes canais é obrigatória para estas funções específicas.

Somos uma empresa comprometida com a saúde e bem-estar das nossas pessoas colaboradoras. Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios Flex, que inclui:

WELLHUB: Você receberá o plano Gold+ do Wellhub de graça e outros planos premium com descontos significativos. Você vai poder acessar diversas academias e estúdios fitness, além de soluções de bem-estar, incluindo meditação, nutrição, saúde mental, rotina de sono e mais.

WELLNESS: Seguro Saúde, Odontológico e Seguro de Vida.

CRESCIMENTO PROFISSIONAL: Excelentes oportunidades de crescimento pessoal e profissional com foco no seu desenvolvimento.

description:
Selecione a frequência (em dias) de recebimento de alertas:

Nós acreditamos que a energia que você dedica à sua carreira merece retorno.
Por isso, reconhecemos a dedicação das nossas pessoas e estamos sempre em busca de quem deseja fazer a diferença e construir uma trajetória próspera e segura.

Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito.

Analista de Data Analytics Local Pl – Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência

Modelo de trabalho:Presencial

Empresa:CPFL Renováveis – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia.

  • Formação Superior Completo em Exatas: Engenharias, Estatística, Matemática, Física, Ciência da Computação, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Necessário experiência na área de ciência de dados;
  • Capacidade analítica e facilidade em modelar, interpretar e apresentar resultados;
  • Conhecimento em programação para análise de dados (Ex: Python, Spark);
  • Desejável conhecimento em construção de consultas em bancos de dados (Ex: SQL);
  • Desejável inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Campinas/SP.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Executar análise avançada de dados (advanced analytics/ data science) utilizando conceitos de big data, para gerar insights para as áreas de negócio do grupo CPFL;
  • Avaliar, propor e implementar metodologias estatística, de inteligência artificial e machine learning, avaliando o contexto, prazo de entrega e dados disponíveis;
  • Liderar projetos de análise de dados com outras áreas para ganhos operacionais nas diversas unidades de negócio, construindo relacionamento com outras áreas, buscando oportunidades, subsídios para compreensão do escopo de trabalho e entendimento das regras envolvidas no negócio.
  • Trabalhar na aquisição e tratamento de dados de dados complexos, com foco em alta volumetria, criando códigos de extração replicáveis;
  • Realizar apresentações de nivelamento e resultados para todos os públicos da CPFL, incluindo reports aos executivos do grupo e redigir relatório de análise documentando os estudos realizados.
  • Acompanhar execução dos modelos em produção, geração de indicadores de desempenhos e definição do momento em que os modelos precisam de atualização;

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços .

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso praticamos ações afirmativas em que reservamos vagas para aumentar cada vez mais a representatividade de grupos sociais minorizados, como por exemplo, mulheres, pessoas com deficiência e pessoas negras. Valorizamos a diversidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Oil Marketing Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Marketing Specialist to join the Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division of Crude Oil Sales & Marketing Dept (COSMD).

The Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division is responsible for providing oil market analysis, market intelligence and data analytics, strategic studies and market research, as well as project management and coordination within the crude oil sales and marketing department.

Your primary role is to oversee and manage various marketing activities, drive marketing research initiatives, and optimize performance to support the company’s overall marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide expertise in a specialized area with crude oil placement strategy and market analysis.
  • Participate in analysis and strategy development that addresses short- and long-term needs, highly complex issues and challenges.
  • Mentor, train, and develop others to provide awareness of the complex concepts within crude oil markets.
  • Undertake complex studies within your developed area of expertise in crude oil placement strategy and market analysis that can impact the company’s present and future operations.
  • Monitor the development of existing and emerging market trends to forecast their viability and evolution over time.
  • Frequently direct and/or coordinate work task forces on special studies and consult directly with Executive Management on issues as they arise.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance on complex planning and analysis problems to senior planning and analytical personnel and to Executive Management.
  • Collaborate with partners and key internal and external stakeholders on low carbon value proposition, presentation of analytical results as well as support in establishing an organization focused on low carbon product.
  • Provide quantitative and qualitative analysis to support the areas of commercializing low carbon crude oil and low carbon products such as LCAF, SAF, Naphtha and others with focus on offsetting and carbon markets mechanisms.
  • Prepare and present plans, analyses, interpretations, conclusions and recommendations to Management and others on a broad range of petroleum market issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Environmental Science or equivalent from a recognized and approved program.
  • Advanced degree in economics, energy, or MBA is preferred.
  • Over 12 years of experience in oil and gas sustainability, Environment, Social & Governance (ESG) and carbon market industry.
  • Knowledge of carbon markets and environmental regulations related to GHG Emissions with understanding of the compliance carbon markets, voluntary carbon markets, baseline and crediting mechanisms, carbon-related trade measures and carbon pricing.
  • Extensive knowledge of global crude oil market balances and flows; pricing dynamics and structures; and methodologies of reporting agencies and exchange contracts.
  • Familiarity with refinery and petrochemicals, linear programming, and investment financial modeling is preferred.
  • Understanding of refining and refining economics.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from qualified candidates.

title: Commission Analyst
description:
Overview

TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you\'ll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you\'ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking a Commissions Analyst to ensure accuracy, responsiveness, and scalability in how commissions and revenue operations are managed in a dynamic, high-growth environment with multiple commission plans, frequent changes, and evolving billing needs.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has a meticulous eye for detail, and is energized by building efficient processes that reduce risk and improve visibility. You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver timely and accurate commissions, resolve system issues, and implement process improvements that scale with the business. This role is critical to ensuring commissions are paid correctly and on time, while also strengthening revenue recognition and reporting processes.

Responsibilities

  • Accurate and reliable commissions: Ensure commission processes are managed with precision, supporting timely and error-free payouts that build trust across the sales organization.
  • Clear visibility into revenue operations: Strengthen reporting and data integrity in Spiff, Salesforce, and billing systems, enabling leadership to make confident, data-driven decisions.
  • Proactive issue resolution: Help surface and address discrepancies in opportunities, contracts, or commission data early, minimizing downstream risks and delays.
  • Scalable processes and automation: Contribute to the design of workflows and reporting that reduce manual effort, improve transparency, and adapt as the business grows.
  • Cross-functional alignment: Build strong relationships with Sales, Finance, and Operations by serving as a reliable partner and trusted resource on commissions and revenue reporting.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in revenue operations, commissions administration, or related finance roles, ideally in a SaaS or high-growth environment.
  • Strong technical proficiency with commissions tools (Spiff preferred), Salesforce CRM, and billing/AR platforms, with the ability to implement changes and troubleshoot independently.
  • Background in accounting operations (billing, invoicing, AR, or contract review) that strengthens commission accuracy and revenue reporting.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, paired with an ownership mindset and ability to manage 3–4 concurrent projects without delays.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in reconciliations, variance analysis, and supporting ASC 340-40 compliance.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who provides fast, reliable support to cross-functional stakeholders.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you\'ll be joining a team that\'s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full-time employees. TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you\'re optimizing for work-life balance, we encourage you to ask about balance within teams and reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.

The Stakes Are Real: Our work has direct, real-world impact, including supporting urgent government requests, terrorist financing investigations, and global security efforts. We also build new processes quickly to stop criminals before they cash out and analyze blockchain data to recover stolen savings.

Life at TRM

As a remote-first company, TRM is built for global collaboration. We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication and meaningful relationships, invest in offsites and onboarding buddies, and prioritize trust and belonging.

Join our mission. We\'re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. If you’re excited about TRM\'s mission, we want to hear from you. TRM is remote-first, with a globally distributed team.

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

MUST HAVE

You bring both the technical depth to design and deploy complex ML systems and the business intuition to know what actually moves KPIs. Specifically:

description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A global creative technology group that blends design and engineering at scale to help leading brands navigate emerging technologies and changing consumer behaviors.


Job Summary

We’re seeking a Solutions Architect with deep expertise in ContentStack to lead the replatforming of a major website from WordPress to a modern headless CMS. This is a short-term, 1.5-month project, where you’ll act as the technical visionary, designing a scalable, efficient, and future-proof content architecture that maximizes the power of the ContentStack platform.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the content modeling effort in ContentStack, ensuring logical, reusable, and optimized structures for authoring and multi-channel delivery.

  • Analyze existing WordPress plugins, themes, and custom functionality to define the migration strategy and headless replacements.

  • Create detailed technical specifications, architecture diagrams, and best practice guidelines for the development team.

  • Select and integrate complementary technologies (e.g., Next.js, Gatsby, CDNs, DAMs) to complete the solution.

  • Advise on ContentStack stack, environment, and user management strategies.

  • Provide expert guidance on headless CMS concepts, performance, security, and scalability.

  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente;
  • Programa de sócios do Agi, o Tô de Dono/a;
  • Universidade interna, a Uni Agi;
  • Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário;
  • Pesquisa semanal de clima, a Sem Climão;
  • Avaliação de performance;
  • Teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, com o Conexão Saúde;
  • Licença-maternidade de 6 meses e licença-paternidade de 20 dias;
  • Dr. Pet: possibilidade fazer plano de saúde para o seu pet com até 20% de desconto;
  • Auxílio-creche.
  • Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas, Indaiatuba e São Paulo (Barra Funda, Eldorado e Paulista). São lugares reserváveis, com chegada às 8h e saída às 18h.

Conheça nossa cultura

O Agibank é para quem vive em eterna busca de conhecimento e não para mesmo quando tudo e todos jogam contra.

Quem faz parte, sabe que, ao superar desafios, coisas boas acontecem para o cliente, para a empresa e para sua própria carreira. Aqui, a gente se orgulha de reunir uma galera assim: agilizada, gente aberta, corajosa e que busca crescimento.

Prepare-se para sair totalmente da zona de conforto , para escutar feedbacks empáticos, mas radicalmente francos, e para transformar todos os desafios em oportunidade de aprendizado.

No Agibank, a vontade de crescer corre na veia, e quando essa vontade se junta, ela não pede licença. E o ambiente abre passagem para quem transforma caminho em estrada.

Juntos, lutamos por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros.

Se você sentiu seu coração bater forte daí, o Agibank pode ser pra você. Vamos crescer juntos?

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Na TAG, acreditamos que o conhecimento aplicável é capaz de revolucionar o mercado financeiro e torná-lo mais transparente, acessível e inclusivo. E é por isso que aqui oferecemos soluções tecnológicas para registrar o volume financeiro que o estabelecimento comercial tem a receber pela venda no cartão dos seus produtos e serviços, promovendo o acesso democrático ao crédito e ajudando a fomentar novos negócios por todo o país.

Aqui, você vai trabalhar com um time apaixonado por desafios, que respira tecnologia no dia a dia e é referência no mercado por inovação e expertise. Tudo isso de forma 100% remota, em home office. Quer saber como funciona uma Registradora de Recebíveis? Acesse nosso site .

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser uma pessoa Product Manager:

Buscamos um(a) Product Manager para garantir a qualidade e atuar na evolução estratégica da nossa plataforma de registro e escrituração de Duplicatas Escriturais. Sua missão será conduzir o produto em um ecossistema financeiro interoperável e dinâmico, assegurando total aderência às normas do Banco Central (especialmente a Resolução BCB nº 339/23) e às regras de negócio definidas na Convenção de Duplicatas Escriturais.

Você será uma peça-chave para conectar a estratégia de negócio às necessidades do mercado e à execução técnica. Seu desafio será navegar a complexidade regulatória, identificar oportunidades de alto impacto e guiar um time multidisciplinar na construção de soluções que resolvem problemas reais para nossos clientes, gerenciando a integração do ativo com outros instrumentos e obrigações financeiras do mercado.

  • Definição da Visão e Governança do Roadmap: Conduzir a criação, comunicação e governança do roadmap estratégico do produto, balanceando com maestria as demandas regulatórias mandatórias, as evoluções da Convenção, as necessidades dos clientes e a visão de longo prazo do negócio.
  • Liderança de Discovery e Estratégia de Mercado: Liderar o processo de discovery contínuo para identificar e validar novas oportunidades, analisando o cenário competitivo, o impacto sistêmico de novas regulações e as dores do cliente para fundamentar as decisões estratégicas do produto.
  • Tradução Estratégica para a Execução: Traduzir os objetivos de negócio e as complexas exigências regulatórias em épicos e diretrizes claras para o time de Product Owners, garantindo que as histórias de usuário e os critérios de aceite estejam sempre alinhados com a visão macro.
  • Gestão de Stakeholders e Risco Sistêmico: Gerenciar as expectativas e o alinhamento com stakeholders de alto nível (Diretoria, Jurídico, Risco, Compliance), antecipando e mitigando riscos inerentes às soluções propostas, considerando implicações financeiras, de negócio e de experiência do cliente em múltiplos domínios.
  • Definição de Métricas e OKRs: Estabelecer os Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) e Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) do produto, definindo o que é sucesso e garantindo que o time esteja focado em métricas de impacto que movem os ponteiros do negócio.
  • Condução da Interoperabilidade: Orientar a estratégia de integração e evolução da nossa plataforma frente às demais IURs (Infraestruturas do Mercado Financeiro) signatárias da Convenção, assegurando nossa posição e competitividade no ecossistema.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência consolidada na liderança estratégica de produtos, definindo a visão e o roadmap de plataformas transacionais complexas.
  • Forte afinidade e vivência em tecnologia, com capacidade para navegar em discussões técnicas e arquiteturais.
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes de negócio regulados pelo Banco Central do Brasil, com habilidade para traduzir normas em estratégia de produto.
  • Domínio do ciclo de vida de produtos, do discovery ao lançamento e iteração contínua, com foco na jornada do cliente.
  • Comunicação assertiva e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplos stakeholders, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados, com foco na definição e acompanhamento de métricas de negócio para medir o impacto das entregas.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Vivência direta com os desafios e a dinâmica da Convenção de Duplicatas Escriturais e os requisitos da Resolução BCB 339/23.
  • Experiência prática no ecossistema de recebíveis, seja em registradoras (IURs), fintechs de crédito, FIDCs ou no setor bancário.
  • Conhecimento profundo sobre a interoperabilidade entre diferentes Infraestruturas do Mercado Financeiro (IMFs).

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

In this role, you’ll design and lead workflows that combine creativity with automation, ensuring content can be localized, personalized, and delivered faster without sacrificing quality.

You’ll collaborate with creative, ops, and tech teams to push the boundaries of post-production—driving efficiency, profitability, and impact for some of the world’s top brands.
